Spectral Theory of Linear Operators

Let $A$ be an $n \times n$ matrix over field $\mathbb{R}$. A non-zero vector $v$ is called an eigenvector corresponding to eigenvalue $\lambda$ if:

$$A v = \lambda v$$

The characteristic polynomial is given by $p(\lambda) = \det(A - \lambda I) = 0$. Roots of this polynomial provide the spectrum of the operator.
